snippets.code:
# Create a Start-Menu shortcut (PSADT v4)
New-ADTShortcut -Path "$envCommonStartMenuPrograms\<Vendor>\<AppName>.lnk" `
    -TargetPath "$envProgramFiles\<Vendor>\<AppName>\<MainExe>.exe" `
    -IconLocation "$envProgramFiles\<Vendor>\<AppName>\<MainExe>.exe" `
    -WorkingDirectory "$envProgramFiles\<Vendor>\<AppName>"

snippets.name: Remove a certificate by thumbprint
snippets.code:
# Remove a certificate by thumbprint from a LocalMachine store
Remove-Item -Path "Cert:\LocalMachine\TrustedPublisher\<Thumbprint>" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

Set ARP DisplayVersion and Publisher
snippets.code:
# Set DisplayVersion + Publisher on an ARP (Uninstall) entry
# NOTE: Wow6432Node is the 32-bit registry view - drop it for a 64-bit app.
$arp = "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Wow6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\<AppUninstallKey>"
Set-ADTRegistryKey -Key $arp -Name "DisplayVersion" -Value "<Version>"
Set-ADTRegistryKey -Key $arp -Name "Publisher"      -Value "<Publisher>"

snippets.name: Remove branding detection key
snippets.code:
# Remove the package's branding detection key under HKLM\SOFTWARE\VWG\CM (team helper Remove-MTBDetectionKey).
# - No arguments: removes THIS package's own key ($AppFullName) - the usual case (already done in Post-Uninstall).
# - -Name: remove specific OLD keys by their EXACT full package name. No wildcards - the helper does an exact match.
Remove-MTBDetectionKey
# Remove specific predecessor keys instead:
Remove-MTBDetectionKey -Name "<OldPackageFullName1>","<OldPackageFullName2>"

snippets.name: Apply HKCU settings to all users (Invoke-ADTAllUsersRegistryAction)
Active Setup - install + uninstall wiring
snippets.code:
## Per-user configuration via ACTIVE SETUP: the plain-PowerShell stub below runs ONCE per user at their next logon
## (covers users created later). The stub is staged in SupportFiles - EDIT it to add this app's HKCU settings.
$userCfgDir = "$envProgramData\VWG\$($adtSession.AppName)\ActiveSetup"
New-ADTFolder -Path $userCfgDir
Copy-ADTFile -Path "$($adtSession.DirSupportFiles)\<App>_<Version>_ActiveSetup_Install.ps1" -Destination $userCfgDir
Set-ADTActiveSetup -StubExePath "$userCfgDir\<App>_<Version>_ActiveSetup_Install.ps1" -Description 'User_Registries' -Key $AppFullName -ExecutionPolicy 'Bypass'

# --- The above goes in POST-INSTALLATION. The below goes in POST-UNINSTALLATION: ---
## Remove the Active Setup entry (and its per-user replication) + the staged stub on uninstall.
Set-ADTActiveSetup -Key $AppFullName -PurgeActiveSetupKey
Remove-ADTFolder -Path "$envProgramData\VWG\$($adtSession.AppName)\ActiveSetup"

# NOTE: also place the plain-PowerShell stub '<App>_<Version>_ActiveSetup_Install.ps1' in SupportFiles (see the 'Active Setup stub' snippet).

snippets.name: Active Setup stub (save into SupportFiles as <App>_<Version>_ActiveSetup_Install.ps1)
snippets.code:
## Active Setup stub - PLAIN PowerShell (NOT PSADT). Runs ONCE per user at their next logon, in the USER's context,
## from the copy staged under ProgramData. >>> ADD this app's per-user settings in the marked section below. <<<

# Hide the brief console window that appears during Active Setup.
Add-Type -Name Window -Namespace Console -MemberDefinition '
    [DllImport("Kernel32.dll")]
    public static extern IntPtr GetConsoleWindow();
    [DllImport("user32.dll")]
    public static extern bool ShowWindow(IntPtr hWnd, Int32 nCmdShow);
'
function Hide-Console { $p = [Console.Window]::GetConsoleWindow(); [void][Console.Window]::ShowWindow($p, 0) }
Hide-Console

$appname = '<App>_<Version>'
$LogTime = Get-Date -Format 'MM-dd-yyyy_hh-mm-ss'
$LogDir  = "$env:localappdata\VWG\Logs"
$LogFile = Join-Path $LogDir ($appname + '_ActiveSetup_Install.log')
if (!(Test-Path $LogDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $LogDir | Out-Null }
$ParentDirPath = Split-Path $script:MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
"$LogTime : Active Setup started for $appname" >> $LogFile

# =================== PER-USER SETTINGS - EDIT BELOW ===================
# A) Import a .reg into HKCU. Stage the .reg in SupportFiles, copy it beside this stub in POST-INSTALLATION, then at
#    logon it sits next to this file ($ParentDirPath):
#   Start-Process -FilePath "$([Environment]::SystemDirectory)\reg.exe" -ArgumentList "Import `"$ParentDirPath\<App>_Add_HKCU.reg`"" -WindowStyle Hidden -Wait
# B) Or set values directly under the current user's hive:
#   New-Item -Path 'HKCU:\Software\<Vendor>\<App>' -Force | Out-Null
#   Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\<Vendor>\<App>' -Name '<ValueName>' -Value '<Data>'
# =====================================================================

"$LogTime : Active Setup finished for $appname" >> $LogFile
